examples.quote: The first slice admits ordinary, complete, unit-weight, fixed-effect Gaussian mu/sigma and binomial-logit mu models. Normal priors include density constants; ridge adds exactly 0.5 lambda beta squared. Selection uses dpar and final design-matrix column, with explicit intercept policy for whole-block selectors. Zero ridge retains ML and ordinary likelihood controls. Active fits expose local penalized-Hessian curvature; interval and likelihood-comparison methods refuse. SD priors and sampling remain outside this slice.
